'''Talaga Vegas Nights''' was a [[Premiere - Death Star II]] retro tournament on 7 April 2025 at Knight & Day Games, Town Square Las Vegas, 6521 S Las Vegas Blvd.<ref name="dc-venue">"Knight & Day Games (Town Square Las Vegas) 6521 S Las Vegas Blvd", cmoore89 in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (7 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1358877160202571917 Discord message]</ref><ref name="dc-retro">"WORLD CHAMPION OF THE TALAGA VEGAS NIGHTS RETRO EVENT", cmoore89 in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (8 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1359066491017887784 Discord message]</ref><ref name="dc-pds2">"Talaga Nights April 6th-8th in Vegas P-DS2 tournament, casual games, and prizes for all!", redv in #general, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (26 February 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469473628094465/1344415417258741760 Discord message]</ref> The gathering was announced as Talaga Nights for 6–8 April 2025, with that tournament, casual games, and prizes.<ref name="dc-pds2" /> [[Andy Talaga]] finished first.<ref name="dc-order">"Final standings", andytalaga in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (8 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1359049790230630491 Discord message]</ref><ref name="dc-scores">"Final standings with differentials", cmoore89 in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (9 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1359396249857556621 Discord message]</ref><ref name="dc-retro" />

[[Andy Talaga]] locked the decks and said each player would use the same decks for all four rounds.<ref name="dc-locked">"Locked decks" / "the same thing for all 4 rounds", andytalaga in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (3 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1357489775434666004 Discord message]</ref> [[Geoff Bowman]] offered to cover the store's $10-per-player fee. That fee was store credit.<ref name="dc-fee">"the venue charges $10 per head", cmoore89 in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (3 February 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1336122631979532289 Discord message]</ref> [[Geoff Bowman]] said the field was an even eight.<ref name="dc-eight">"Looks like an even 8", redv in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (7 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1358856871951339623 Discord message]</ref>

== Prizes ==
On 7 April 2025, cmoore89 said every player would receive three sealed Decipher packs.<ref name="dc-sealed">"Every player will receive 3 sealed Decipher packs", cmoore89 in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (7 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1358857333270118503 Discord message]</ref> [[Andy Talaga]] said his 24 packs would be three to each player, with one extra for first, one extra for last, and one extra for a player he chose.<ref name="dc-andy-packs">"3 to each player", andytalaga in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (7 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1358858380629770441 Discord message]</ref> On 9 April 2025 he said the prizes generally included three of his custom Reflections packs, two tech mor custom Aurebesh packs, four Players Committee Advocate Award packs, three or four Decipher packs from Premiere through Jabba's Palace, one larger pack, a Las Vegas SWCCG pin, a Las Vegas SWCCG sticker, and a location card signed by all eight players.<ref name="dc-prizes">"3 Andy custom reflections packs", andytalaga in #talaga-vegas-nights, Retro Club Discord (9 April 2025). [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1333518121801093170/1359382603773247560 Discord message]</ref>
